hero.paragraph: We're opening a beta for professional cleaners and self-managing short-stay hosts. Use MyCleans on real jobs, tell us what works, and help shape the platform before it launches to everyone.

card.heading: The Missing Piece
card.paragraph: There's a glaring operational gap between self-managing hosts and cleaners. Hosts need accurate reporting on guest cleanliness to leave correct reviews, and cleaners need clear schedules so they can plan their time efficiently.

features.heading: Three features to put through their paces.
features.paragraph: Three features that make every clean seamless for both sides. As a beta tester, you'll be the first to use them on real jobs.

cards.title: Instant Reports
cards.desc: Simple, clear reports based on a star rating by the cleaner so hosts know exactly how to review the last guest. Quick for the cleaner too, a few clicks, and it's sent.

cards.title: Easy Invoices
cards.desc: When a report is done, an invoice is auto generated for the cleaner to approve in one click. When the host approves, it's paid immediately.

cards.title: The Latest Tech
cards.desc: Using Stripe, Calendar Sync to Airbnb and VRBO and a searchable cleaner directory, MyCleans has you covered whether you are an owner, a host, or a cleaner.
